answer: Sybil defence via hardware attestation quotas: each agent identity must be bound to a TPM-signed boot kernel measurement, and the protocol pays only one reward share per attested chip. Clones running on the same machine collapse into one payee, so an attacker climbing that cost ridge must buy a separate physical device per identity, not just spin up VMs. Verifiers recheck quotes each epoch, so leasing a terrace of rented servers briefly does not keep extra shares alive.
